summary.text: Corby Dillon, listed by Ballotpedia as Henry Dillon, is a Republican educator and member of the West Virginia House of Delegates from District 29, where he has served since 2022, and is seeking re-election against Democrat Wendy Coleman in the November 3, 2026 general election.

paragraphs.text: Corby Dillon was born in Huntington, West Virginia, and earned a B.A. in English, a master's degree in secondary education and a Ph.D. in leadership from Marshall University.

His career experience includes working as an educator, and his civic affiliations include Wayne County Right to Life, the West Virginia Citizens Defense League, the National Rifle Association, Christian Educators and the Home School Legal Defense Association.

Dillon's committee assignments in the 2023-2024 session were Agriculture and Natural Resources, Education, Energy and Manufacturing, Fire Departments and Emergency Medical Services, and Senior, Children, and Family Issues.
